name: dsh-workspace-lock
description: Per-workspace password locks for the DSH web GUI: bw-independent: right-click a workspace in the sidebar (own menu; injects into dsh-better-workspace context menu when available) to 加锁/解锁/移除锁; a locked workspace's sessions hide in the sidebar and the center column shows a lock screen until the password is entered (page-scoped; a refresh locks again). An admin master password (Settings → Plugins → dsh-workspace-lock) unlocks every workspace at once and authorizes any unlock/remove; it is stored only as a salted hash. UI-level lock only.
